verdict.rationale: Logseq offers generic extension points that external AI tools could plausibly use: a third-party plugin marketplace with community plugin-API docs, a local HTTP API server for authorized external access to the graph, and a `logseq://` protocol for third-party apps. None of the evidence shows first-party AI connectors or AI-specific plugins, so AI integration is only implied by general-purpose APIs. One user also reports losing the ability to have Claude/Codex write or update pages after the move to the DB version. Missing for 10: first-party LLM connectors, any evidenced AI plugins in the marketplace, documentation of connecting external LLMs to notes, and hands-on corroboration of AI tool integration working in the current version.
